forbidden.name: no-client-to-server
forbidden.comment: UI or app code must not import from server-only modules

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: No circular dependencies

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Orphan modules should be documented or removed

forbidden.name: no-domain-to-ui
forbidden.comment: Domain layer must stay pure (no UI or route awareness)

forbidden.name: no-lib-to-ui
forbidden.comment: Low-level lib/shared code must not depend on UI

forbidden.name: no-server-leak
forbidden.comment: Server (infrastructure) code must not import from presentation layers

forbidden.name: no-upward-layer-imports-app
forbidden.comment: Non-app layers must not import app route layer

forbidden.name: no-upward-layer-imports-ui
forbidden.comment: Lower layers must not import UI layer

forbidden.name: no-legacy-components-imports
forbidden.comment: Phase out legacy src/components usage in favor of src/ui; allow bridging wrappers only

forbidden.name: no-cross-feature-internals
forbidden.comment: Feature internals (inventory/orders/marketing/etc) exposed only via their index/facade

forbidden.name: prefer-facade-marketing
forbidden.comment: UI should import marketing only through facade

forbidden.name: no-test-imports
forbidden.comment: Production code must not import from test files

forbidden.name: no-deep-relative-traversal
forbidden.comment: Discourage brittle deep ../../ relative imports – use path aliases

forbidden.name: enforce-alias-for-ui
forbidden.comment: UI modules should be imported via @ui/* alias (no long relative paths)

forbidden.name: no-orphan-allowlist
forbidden.comment: Explicitly allow known intentional entry-point or framework orphans; warn on others

forbidden.name: no-shared-to-domain-backref
forbidden.comment: Shared utilities should not depend on domain logic (keep shared lowest)

forbidden.name: no-circular-critical
forbidden.comment: Escalate circulars in domain & lib to error

forbidden.name: ui-no-server-alias
forbidden.comment: UI must not import @server alias directly

forbidden.name: no-repo-direct-in-ui
forbidden.comment: UI must not touch *repo.ts directly (use service/facade)

forbidden.name: no-service-direct-in-app
forbidden.comment: Route layer should consume only facades or index barrels (not raw services)
